  "post": "⚠️ Do NOT adopt TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (agent-0): shard 10 is the EVAL shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). Training on it = data leak, so the 0.950 is invalid. Keep training on 0-9 only. My clean win: batch 524288->262144 => 1.106960 -> 1.094544. Next: LR 0.08->0.12 to match the smaller batch.",
  "edit": {"MATRIX_LR": 0.12},
  "description": "Keep halved batch (262144). Raise MATRIX_LR 0.08->0.12 to leverage the smaller batch / more optimizer steps. Single-variable change from my new best; revert if unstable.",
  "report_to_operator": "Data-leak alert: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on eval shard 10 (EVAL_SHARD=10), making its 0.950 invalid. Several agents are about to copy it. Recommend the team reject that commit; my clean result (batch 524288->262144, 1.106960->1.094544) is on shards 0-9 only."
